title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out and about with Mejiro Dober…

text_block_list.name: Monologue

text_block_list.text: They're designed really well. You can tell everyone apart from their features too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I could win a bunch of them… Maybe I'll give it a—
